honesty.colours_are_authored: every colour, roughness and metalness in both catalogues is AUTHORED - chosen by eye against what the material is, and never sampled from a photograph, a measured swatch or a supplier's data. What is DERIVED is only which hall stands on which, read from the trade's own words.
honesty.status: general good practice, not a code reference; no figure is read from any jurisdiction's standard and no surface names a product, brand, fire rating or specification number. A real deployment replaces these with the local standard.

bare-slab.name: Power-floated bare slab
bare-slab.why: non-combustible with nothing underfoot to carry flame or spark

sealed-slab.name: Sealed concrete slab
sealed-slab.why: dust-proofed general working floor that survives point loads

broom-concrete.name: Broom-finish concrete
broom-concrete.why: traction outdoors and on wash-down ramps

epoxy-smooth.name: Smooth epoxy resin
epoxy-smooth.why: wipe-clean and chemical-resistant for controlled rooms

epoxy-quartz.name: Quartz-broadcast epoxy
epoxy-quartz.why: keeps grip when the process runs wet or oily

spill-berm.name: Bermed epoxy with coved edge
spill-berm.why: contains a spill at the room boundary until it is recovered

welded-vinyl.name: Welded sheet vinyl
welded-vinyl.why: particulates collect in joints, so the floor has none

esd-vinyl.name: Static-dissipative vinyl
esd-vinyl.why: bleeds charge to ground before it can find a spark path

rubber-dielectric.name: Dielectric rubber matting
rubber-dielectric.why: insulates the person standing at live equipment

anti-fatigue.name: Anti-fatigue matting
anti-fatigue.why: long standing bench work punishes joints on hard floor

firebrick-hearth.name: Firebrick hearth
firebrick-hearth.why: it will be spilled on, and must take molten metal

acid-brick.name: Acid-resistant brick
acid-brick.why: shrugs off the chemistry a plating or wash-down bay throws

steel-checker.name: Checkerplate steel
steel-checker.why: grip where machines drip oil, and it can be hosed

steel-grate.name: Open steel grating
steel-grate.why: the floor drains itself where water is the work

marine-deck.name: Non-skid marine deck
marine-deck.why: grip that survives immersion and salt

end-grain-block.name: End-grain wood block
end-grain-block.why: kind to a dropped edge tool, and quiet underfoot

timber-plank.name: Heavy timber planking
timber-plank.why: the substrate formwork and carpentry actually fasten into

raised-access.name: Raised access floor
raised-access.why: the services run under the floor, not across it

terrazzo-ground.name: Ground terrazzo
terrazzo-ground.why: a finish trade shows its own craft where people gather

porcelain-tile.name: Porcelain tile
porcelain-tile.why: hard, flat and truthful under a straightedge

crushed-stone.name: Compacted crushed stone
crushed-stone.why: the ground plant actually digs, piles and tracks on

asphalt-apron.name: Asphalt apron
asphalt-apron.why: the yard running surface between door and stockpile

polished-slab.name: Ground and polished slab
polished-slab.why: a concrete trade grinds its own floor back to the aggregate to show what it put down

steel-diamond.name: Diamond tread plate
steel-diamond.why: a raised lozenge holds a boot on a deck a machine leaks onto

steel-plate.name: Sealed steel plate deck
steel-plate.why: a welded deck spreads a point load and can be cut and let back in

terrazzo-divider.name: Divider-strip terrazzo
terrazzo-divider.why: the strip is where the pour stops and the next one starts, and setting it out is the whole of the craft

flake-resin.name: Broadcast flake resin
flake-resin.why: flake hides the drip and the scuff a coating bay makes daily

resin-screed.name: Heavy-duty resin screed
resin-screed.why: takes steam and cold water an hour apart without lifting

conductive-tile.name: Conductive floor tile
conductive-tile.why: charge has to reach earth faster than the atmosphere can find a spark

trench-drain.name: Floor to falls with trench drain
trench-drain.why: the wash water leaves by a route somebody chose

foundry-sand.name: Rammed moulding-sand floor
foundry-sand.why: the floor and the mould are the same material, and the pour goes into both

rail-ballast.name: Ballasted track bed
rail-ballast.why: the track is only as true as the stone under it, so the stone is the floor

interlock-paver.name: Interlocking concrete paving
interlock-paver.why: a buried-service trade has to lift the surface and put it back the same afternoon

access-perf.name: Perforated access floor tile
access-perf.why: the cold air arrives through the floor, and which tile is open is a decision somebody logs

shotcrete-invert.name: Shotcrete invert
shotcrete-invert.why: the floor of a heading is sprayed the same hour the roof is

tooling-plate.name: T-slotted cast-iron floor plate
tooling-plate.why: a workpiece is only square to what it is clamped to

strippable-coat.name: Strippable decontamination coating
strippable-coat.why: the contamination leaves with the coating instead of with the person

impact-mat.name: Impact-absorbing mat
impact-mat.why: a fall-arrest demonstration ends on the floor, and this is the floor it should end on

oak-strip.name: White oak strip floor
oak-strip.why: the hardwood a joinery trade lays in its own meeting room, because the room is the first thing it is judged on

ash-board.name: Ash board floor
ash-board.why: pale, straight-grained and cheap to lift when the cable under the record room floor has to be got at

heart-pine-reclaimed.name: Reclaimed heart pine
heart-pine-reclaimed.why: lifted out of an old mill floor and laid again: the board room of a trade that argues for reuse should be made of it

maple-strip.name: Hard maple strip floor
maple-strip.why: the hardest of the common shop timbers, and the one a bench room floor survives a dropped chisel on

douglas-fir-plank.name: Douglas fir plank
douglas-fir-plank.why: the stock a framing trade racks, laid as the floor of the room it is racked in

beech-block.name: Beech end-grain block
beech-block.why: end grain takes a blade point-first and closes behind it, which is why a cutting bench stands on it

teak-deck.name: Laid teak deck
teak-deck.why: the deck a shipwright lays and caulks, and the one piece of their work anybody outside the yard ever walks on

iroko-bench-deck.name: Iroko bench decking
iroko-bench-deck.why: oily enough to sit in salt water and not move, which is the whole reason a fitting-out bench is built of it

bamboo-strand.name: Strand-woven bamboo
bamboo-strand.why: a floor-laying trade keeps a bay of the newest substrate it is asked to lay over, and this is currently that

oak-end-block.name: Oak end-grain block
oak-end-block.why: a fitter kneels at a stripped machine for an hour, and oak end grain is kinder to a knee than steel and harder than a mat

larch-decking.name: Open larch decking
larch-decking.why: slatted and laid clear of the ground, so a store where everything arrives wet drains instead of rotting

rail-timber-waybeam.name: Timber waybeam
rail-timber-waybeam.why: the longitudinal timber a rail sits on where there is no ballast to sit in, and the thing a signals hall racks

linoleum-sheet.name: Welded linoleum sheet
linoleum-sheet.why: linseed oil and cork dust on jute: warm underfoot, and it takes a dropped instrument without chipping

rubber-sheet-safety.name: Welded rubber sheet
rubber-sheet-safety.why: a rescue drill puts people on the floor repeatedly, and rubber sheet is what stops that becoming the injury

vct-tile.name: Vinyl composition tile
vct-tile.why: cheap, replaceable one tile at a time, and the reason a record room floor can be repaired on a Friday afternoon

safety-vinyl-grit.name: Grit-grip safety vinyl
safety-vinyl-grit.why: carborundum through the wear layer, for the floor between a wet plant room and a dry corridor

esd-rubber.name: Static-dissipative rubber
esd-rubber.why: bleeds a charge away slowly enough not to be a shock path and fast enough not to let one build at a cell rack

epoxy-oxide-red.name: Oxide-red epoxy coating
epoxy-oxide-red.why: red reads as the working bay in every yard that uses colour at all, and a trainee learns the convention by walking it

epoxy-plant-green.name: Plant-room green epoxy
epoxy-plant-green.why: green is the safe route through a plant room, and the floor is where the route is drawn

epoxy-slate-blue.name: Slate-blue epoxy coating
epoxy-slate-blue.why: a cold blue under array work makes a dropped washer visible instead of lost

urethane-aisle-yellow.name: Aisle-yellow urethane coat
urethane-aisle-yellow.why: the aisle is the drawing: a plant yard is set out in yellow before it is set out on paper

mma-fast-cure.name: Fast-cure acrylic coating
mma-fast-cure.why: goes down and is walked on the same shift, which is the only reason a room in use can be recoated at all

polyurea-deck.name: Polyurea deck coating
polyurea-deck.why: sprayed thick over a steel deck and flexible enough to stay stuck to it while the deck works

flake-terracotta.name: Terracotta flake resin
flake-terracotta.why: warm flake hides the overspray a coating bay makes every day without hiding a spill

quartz-graphite.name: Graphite quartz broadcast
quartz-graphite.why: dark and hard: a shot-loading bench wants grip and wants nothing that sparks

quarry-tile.name: Unglazed quarry tile
quarry-tile.why: fired through, so it wears to the same colour it started and a chipped corner is not a pale scar

porcelain-charcoal.name: Charcoal porcelain tile
porcelain-charcoal.why: a dark, flat floor is the fairest ground to judge a light finish sample against

porcelain-sand.name: Sand porcelain tile
porcelain-sand.why: warm and low-contrast, so a glazing trade reads the light coming through a bay rather than the floor bouncing it

slate-flag.name: Riven slate flag
slate-flag.why: split rather than sawn, so no two flags are the same thickness and bedding them is the skill

limestone-flag.name: Limestone flag
limestone-flag.why: the stone the banker shop cuts, laid whole where the hall wants to show what it cuts

granite-sett.name: Granite sett paving
granite-sett.why: small, square and laid to a cambered fall: the paving a crew still sets by eye and a string line

clay-paver.name: Clay paver floor
clay-paver.why: lifted, stacked and relaid the same afternoon, which is the whole argument for a paved surface over a poured one

terrazzo-marble.name: Marble-chip terrazzo
terrazzo-marble.why: the chip is the finish: what is ground back decides the floor, and choosing it is the trade

terrazzo-glass.name: Recycled-glass terrazzo
terrazzo-glass.why: crushed glass in the matrix instead of stone, which grinds differently and is the argument a sample bay exists to settle

granolithic-screed.name: Granolithic screed
granolithic-screed.why: a wearing topping laid monolithic with the slab under it, and the thing a stock bay actually needs

polished-black.name: Black-pigmented polished slab
polished-black.why: pigment through the pour and ground back: the finish a concrete trade puts in its own board room to end the argument

alu-tread.name: Aluminium tread plate
alu-tread.why: a magazine tool store wants a floor that cannot strike a spark off a dropped steel tool

galv-checker.name: Galvanised checkerplate
galv-checker.why: the zinc is why it can stand under a weld bay that gets hosed out and still be there in ten years

stainless-deck.name: Stainless plate deck
stainless-deck.why: wiped down every shift and never rusts into the wipe, which is what a controlled room means by cleanable

alu-bar-grating.name: Aluminium bar grating
alu-bar-grating.why: light enough that one person lifts a panel to get at the pipework the grating is there to cover

perf-alu-tile.name: Perforated aluminium tile
perf-alu-tile.why: open area, in a floor whose whole job is to hand cold air upward where somebody decided it should go

slot-drain-resin.name: Resin floor to falls with slot drain
slot-drain-resin.why: a wash bay is a floor with a decision in it: where the water goes, and how fast

sprayed-fibrecrete.name: Sprayed fibre-reinforced concrete
sprayed-fibrecrete.why: fibre instead of mesh, so the invert of a heading can be sprayed in one pass behind the face

dry-shake-topping.name: Metallic dry-shake topping
dry-shake-topping.why: iron aggregate floated into the green slab: the hardest wearing surface a demolition yard can put under tracked plant

anhydrite-screed.name: Anhydrite flowing screed
anhydrite-screed.why: poured level by its own weight, which is why a long shop floor can be flat without anyone tamping it

blast-grit-bed.name: Blast-grit floor
blast-grit-bed.why: the spent grit IS the floor of a blast bay until it is swept and screened, and it is walked on in that state

painted-block.name: Painted concrete block
painted-block.why: the general working wall: takes a knock, takes a repaint

impact-block.name: Impact-faced block with kerb
impact-block.why: stock and plant hit this wall, so the bottom of it is the part that is built to be hit

liner-panel.name: Washable liner panel
liner-panel.why: a practice bay gets hosed out, and a lined wall sheds water instead of soaking it

ply-lined.name: Plywood-lined shop wall
ply-lined.why: you hang tools, jigs and a cut list off a wall you can screw into

whiteboard-panel.name: Full-height marker panel
whiteboard-panel.why: setting out is drawn before it is built, and the wall is the first place it gets drawn

matte-board.name: Matte low-glare board
matte-board.why: inspection reads surfaces at a raking angle, and a shiny wall throws the light back into the work

acoustic-panel.name: Fabric-faced acoustic panel
acoustic-panel.why: a room where people talk over each other is a room where the decision gets made twice

firebrick-face.name: Firebrick wall face
firebrick-face.why: the wall beside a pour takes the same spatter the hearth does

weld-screen.name: Non-combustible screened bay
weld-screen.why: the arc is not only the welder's problem: the bay walls stop the flash reaching the next bay

chem-tile.name: Glazed chemical-resistant tile
chem-tile.why: what the floor shrugs off, the splash-back has to shrug off too

coved-white.name: Coved cleanable wall
coved-white.why: a square corner is somewhere particulate can sit, so the room has no square corners

mesh-guard.name: Guarded mesh partition
mesh-guard.why: you have to see into a bay you are not allowed to walk into

brick-common.name: Common brick wall
brick-common.why: a bricklaying hall is judged on a wall, so the hall has one to be judged against

ashlar-stone.name: Coursed ashlar stone
ashlar-stone.why: the banker shop matches an existing course, and the course has to be on the wall to be matched

glazed-curtain.name: Glazed curtain wall bay
glazed-curtain.why: a glazing trade tests against a real bay, because a sealed joint only fails where the light gets in

corrugated-steel.name: Profiled steel cladding
corrugated-steel.why: the cladding trade fixes to the wall it also makes, and the rib spacing is the whole argument

stainless-splash.name: Stainless splash-back
stainless-splash.why: a wall that is wiped down every shift should not be made of something that minds being wiped down

gunned-castable.name: Gunned refractory castable
gunned-castable.why: a lining is sprayed, not laid, and what it looks like wet is what it looks like for the next four years

poly-enclosure.name: Sheeted negative-pressure enclosure
poly-enclosure.why: the room is built the morning the work starts and binned the evening it clears

switchgear-lineup.name: Switchgear lineup face
switchgear-lineup.why: in an electrical room the wall IS the equipment, and the labels on it are the only map anyone has

perf-acoustic.name: Perforated metal acoustic liner
perf-acoustic.why: a machine hall is loud because the walls give it all back, unless the walls are built not to

rock-face.name: Shotcreted rock face
rock-face.why: underground the wall is the ground, and what holds it up is sprayed onto it

tank-plate.name: Lapped tank plate
tank-plate.why: you enter a vessel through a shell you can read: the laps, the seams and where the primer has gone

oak-panelled.name: Oak-panelled board room
oak-panelled.why: the room where the trade argues about its own standards is panelled to that standard, and everyone in it can see the joint

pine-boarded.name: Whitewood board lining
pine-boarded.why: a boarded wall can be cut into, patched and boarded again, which is what a room used for practice needs

birch-ply-lined.name: Birch ply lining
birch-ply-lined.why: the face veneer is good enough to leave unpainted, so the wall shows every screw somebody put in it

limewashed-brick.name: Limewashed brick
limewashed-brick.why: lime lets the brick behind it dry out, which is the argument a restoration trade has with paint every week

engineering-brick.name: Blue engineering brick
engineering-brick.why: dense enough not to take up water, which is why it is the brick below ground and in a chamber that floods

glazed-brick.name: Glazed white brick
glazed-brick.why: a fired glaze on a structural unit: it washes down like tile and takes a knock like brick

fair-face-concrete.name: Fair-faced concrete
fair-face-concrete.why: the pour is the finish, so the formwork, the release agent and the vibration are all on show and cannot be made good later

board-marked-concrete.name: Board-marked concrete
board-marked-concrete.why: sawn boards used as form face leave their grain in the concrete, and setting them out is the whole of the work

plaster-cream.name: Painted plaster, cream
plaster-cream.why: a warm near-white throws light back into a room people read drawings in without glaring off the paper

plaster-sage.name: Painted plaster, sage
plaster-sage.why: a muted green is the one wall colour a finish sample can be held against without the wall deciding the answer

plaster-slate.name: Painted plaster, slate
plaster-slate.why: dark walls stop a screen-lit room reflecting itself back at the people reading the screens

plaster-ochre.name: Painted plaster, ochre
plaster-ochre.why: earth pigment on lime plaster is the oldest painted wall the trade still makes, and the one it is asked to match

epoxy-wall-coat.name: Epoxy-coated wall
epoxy-wall-coat.why: the coating a coatings trade puts on everyone else's walls, on its own, where the failures can be left up and looked at

perforated-ply.name: Perforated ply acoustic lining
perforated-ply.why: holes and a void behind them: the cheapest honest way to stop a hard room ringing, and visible enough to teach from

terracotta-rainscreen.name: Terracotta rainscreen
terracotta-rainscreen.why: extruded and fired, hung on rails with an open joint, so the cavity behind it does the waterproofing

zinc-standing-seam.name: Zinc standing seam
zinc-standing-seam.why: the seam is folded on site and is the only thing holding the weather out, which is why it is practised indoors first

copper-panel.name: Copper panel
copper-panel.why: it changes colour for thirty years after it is fixed, so a sample wall is the only way to argue about the finish

anodised-alu-panel.name: Anodised aluminium panel
anodised-alu-panel.why: the colour is grown into the oxide rather than painted on, and a scratch cannot be touched in

acoustic-oat.name: Acoustic panel, oatmeal
acoustic-oat.why: a quiet room in a warm colour, because a room people write in all day should not feel like a booth

acoustic-rust.name: Acoustic panel, rust
acoustic-rust.why: the absorber has to be somewhere people look, so it is worth it being a colour they do not mind looking at

metro-tile-white.name: Glazed white wall tile
metro-tile-white.why: a small glazed tile has a lot of grout in it, and keeping that grout sound is the discipline the room is teaching

quarry-tile-wall.name: Green quarry tile
quarry-tile-wall.why: the splash-back behind a wet bench, in a colour that does not show every drip and does show a crack

marker-glass.name: Glass marker wall
marker-glass.why: you can set out full size on glass, wipe it, and see the work through it while you do

ashlar-grey.name: Grey ashlar course
ashlar-grey.why: a second stone to match against, because matching one existing course teaches nothing about matching a different one

brass-screen.name: Brass-infilled screen
brass-screen.why: rope and hardware have to be visible from outside the store without the store being open

motor-control-face.name: Motor control centre face
motor-control-face.why: a wall of starters and their labels: the room is the equipment, and reading it is the lesson

clear-sheet-curtain.name: Clear sheeted curtain
clear-sheet-curtain.why: you can watch a containment being used without being inside it, which is the only safe way to assess one

gunned-insulating.name: Gunned insulating lining
gunned-insulating.why: a practice lining, gunned onto a wall so it can be cut into, read and gunned again next week

patterns.slab: one large pour with its construction joints at the edges
patterns.tile: a square modular tile with a grouted joint on every side
patterns.brick: a stretcher bond with a raked mortar course
patterns.plank: parallel board joints running one way
patterns.block: a coursed unit face, wider than it is tall
patterns.checker: raised two-way bars, the classic plate tread
patterns.grate: bearing bars with open slots between them
patterns.broom: fine combed striations dragged across a green slab
patterns.smooth: no joint at all: a poured film with nothing to catch
patterns.speckle: loose aggregate scattered through the surface
patterns.panel: a ribbed sheet with a seam where two sheets meet
patterns.plywood: sheet edges with the long grain running with them
patterns.board: a flat drawn-on face with a single joint line
patterns.fabric: a fine two-way weave with no hard edges
patterns.screen: a heavy frame with a light infill inside it
patterns.mesh: woven wire you can see through, the wire catching the light
patterns.diamond: raised lozenges in offset rows, the tread of a vehicle deck
patterns.plate: flat plate with a ground weld seam every sheet width
patterns.terrazzo: chip suspended in matrix, divided by a strip on a grid
patterns.flake: irregular colour flake broadcast into a wet resin film
patterns.trench: a floor laid to falls with a slotted drain running the bay
patterns.sand: rammed granular floor, raked and rolled rather than laid
patterns.ballast: crossed sleepers bedded in angular stone
patterns.perf: a modular tile drilled through on a close grid
patterns.tslot: a machined grid of T-slots in a heavy cast face
patterns.polish: saw-cut control joints in a ground face with the aggregate up
patterns.ashlar: squared stone in regular courses with fine joints
patterns.glazing: a glazed bay divided by its transoms and mullions
patterns.corrugate: deep profiled sheet, the ribs running full height
patterns.gunite: sprayed material, lumpy where the nozzle laid it
patterns.sheet: taped polythene sheeting with a lap seam every sheet width
patterns.cabinet: a row of cubicle doors with a handle and a vent on each
